name: glassfitting-poc
description: Web-based AI virtual glasses fitting PoC (MediaPipe Face Landmarker + Three.js)

scripts.setup: npm run setup:models && npm run setup:canonical && npm run setup:frames
scripts.bench:replay: rolldown scripts/bench-replay.ts --format esm --platform node -o bench/bench-replay.bundle.mjs && node bench/bench-replay.bundle.mjs
scripts.bench:fit: rolldown scripts/fit-bench.ts --format esm --platform node -o bench/fit-bench.bundle.mjs && node bench/fit-bench.bundle.mjs
